{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "ionicity_ladder_wide_gap_chemistry_v3",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "closed_shell_ionic_halide",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "halide", "transition_metal_flag": "no_transition_metal"},
          "weight": 0.75,
          "rationale": "Main-group halides are maximally ionic with closed-shell cations; no d-states in the gap, giving the widest experimental gaps."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "oxide_deep_o2p_valence_band",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "oxide"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Large electronegativity difference and deep O 2p valence band place oxides high on the ionicity gap ladder."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "chalcogenide_polarizable_narrow_gap",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "chalcogenide"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Polarizable S/Se/Te p-states raise the valence band and shrink gaps across the largest anion population."
        },
